_note: The What now? card per case type (next-step-per-stage 1.4). `nextStep` holds a case type's own stage texts, keyed on the status role as the case page's card keys them (`intake`, `pending-info`, `in-progress`, `review`, `closed`), each `{ title?, after?, checklist: [{ label, doneField?, doneWhen?, hint? }] }`, or `{ stages: { ... } }`. The case page reads it through `nextStep.stagesFrom: @context.caseType.nextStep`; a case type without it keeps the generic texts. Declared here because OpenRegister stores only declared keys. caseType moves to 1.30.0 so an existing instance re-imports the schema; the file name sorts after every 99-* fragment because the last fragment's scalar `version` wins the merge.

nextStep.title: What now? per stage
nextStep.description: This case type's own texts for the What now? card, per stage. Empty keeps the default texts.
